title: Watch tool calls in a fixed order without changing them
narrative: Fangore starts the CLI host with family `pass_through` and backend `mock`. He binds host lifecycle extensions ['acme:watch_a', 'acme:watch_b'] and runs product step `tool_lifecycle` (mode=tool). He verifies extension effects on the tool/graph path.
implementation: Product verb `tool_lifecycle` (`ToolLifecycleVerb`) with Config/host-bound `LifecycleExtension` instances (story fixtures under tests.stories.hosts).
validation: user_story `lifecycle_extension_observe.yaml` tool_lifecycle; hard expects on extension observations.
